description: This file defines the AfrDataPoint class, representing a data point of air/fuel ratio with associated engine parameters such as RPM and engine load. It includes methods for constructing data points, estimating indices based on RPM and load, and retrieving attribute values.

classes.name: AfrDataPoint
classes.description: Represents an air/fuel ratio data point with associated engine parameters such as RPM and engine load, along with their respective indices.

methods.name: AfrDataPoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing a data point with AFR, index values, RPM, and engine load, with index bounds checking.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Factory method to create an AfrDataPoint instance from AFR, RPM, and engine load, calculating indices based on provided values.

methods.name: getRpm
methods.description: Returns the RPM value of the data point.

methods.name: getEngineLoad
methods.description: Returns the engine load value of the data point.

methods.name: getAfr
methods.description: Returns the AFR (Air/Fuel Ratio) value of the data point.

methods.name: getRpmIndex
methods.description: Returns the index corresponding to the RPM value.

methods.name: getEngineLoadIndex
methods.description: Returns the index corresponding to the engine load.
